away.name: Sergei Bobrovsky
away.news: Despite a 5-2 loss to the Calgary Flames on Monday, in which he allowed three goals on 32 shots (.906 SV%), Bobrovsky will return to the crease on Wednesday. The 38-year-old Bobrovsky has had an inconsistent tenure with the Maple Leafs so far, losing six of nine games (3-4-2) and posting a pedestrian 3.09 GAA and .897 SV%. He is coming off a career-worst season with the Florida Panthers, posting a 3.07 GAA and .877 SV% in 52 games (27-23-1), totals eerily similar to his pace so far in 2026-27. The Maple Leafs enter Wednesday's contest as -129 road favourites against a 7-4-1 Seattle Kraken team.

home.name: Philipp Grubauer
home.news: Grubauer has never lived up to expectations since joining the Seattle Kraken in their inaugural 2021-22 season, but he is off to a strong start in 2026-27. The 34-year-old German goalie was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 33 of 36 shots (.917 SV%) in a 5-3 win over the Utah Mammoth. He has a 2.76 GAA and .907 SV% in seven appearances this season (6-1-1). Seattle enters Wednesday's contest as +120 home underdogs against a Toronto Maple Leafs team coming off a 5-2 loss to the Calgary Flames.
